top_comments.author: @franzbuhlmann1099
top_comments.text:
That price isn’t even the real cost!

At $50K per year that is like paying two full time employees for the same job!

It wouldn’t be so bad if the ROI was comparably as high.

From what I hear, this spend doesn’t even bring results.

If this is true, basically paying for two full time employees without ever generating any return for that expense will bankrupt any normal business. And we are only talking about one person and not even accounting for everyone in that business that the company pays essentially twice.

Is the goal to bankrupt the entire country or destroy it by some other means?

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Yeah paying for “2 employees” that produce nothing will sink any business fast. A lot of that cost is cloud markup and seats. Local setups cut the recurring bill way down.
